items.title: Awesome Neovim
items.content_text:
### File Explorer / Diagnostics

*   [X3eRo0/dired.nvim (⭐161)](https://github.com/X3eRo0/dired.nvim) - A file browser inspired by Emacs Dired.

### Note Taking / Diagnostics

*   [phrmendes/todotxt.nvim (⭐24)](https://github.com/phrmendes/todotxt.nvim) -  A minimal `todo.txt` implementation in Lua.

### Motion / Diagnostics

*   [jinh0/eyeliner.nvim (⭐517)](https://github.com/jinh0/eyeliner.nvim) - Highlight jump destinations for `f`/`t` motions.

### Remote Development / Diagnostics

*   [inhesrom/remote-ssh.nvim (⭐32)](https://github.com/inhesrom/remote-ssh.nvim) - Duplicates the basic ground level functionality of VSCode's Remote-SSH plugin, with a focus on a local editing experience to avoid remote "lag". Browse remote files, edit "remote buffers" with a full local editing experience (LSP, Tree-sitter, Telescope integration, and a file watcher).

items.content_text:
- Name: [Semaphore CE (⭐1.2k)](https://github.com/semaphoreio/semaphore)

  Description: Self-Hosted, Open-Source CI/CD platform

  Features: Runs on Kubernetes or K3s. Scalable, fast, all languages supported

  Supported repositories: GitHub, BitBucket, GitLab, Any Git-SCM server

  Documentation: [Documentation](https://docs.semaphoreci.com/)

  Price: Free OSS (Apache-2)

  Stars: [![Stars](https://img.shields.io/github/stars/semaphoreio/semaphore.svg)](https://github.com/semaphoreio/semaphore)
